QorCap v0.3.41: Call of Duty skips the home/away prompt

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged.

- Picking Call of Duty no longer asks home or away. `start_cod_reader()` gets an explicit `side=None`, so a stale `side_choice.json` is never read. CoD is recorded in the legacy `home` signing-role bucket that receipt.v0 requires (#141).
- Includes RLR Stage A (#140), an offline, read-only, draft description tool, and the CoD owner-row 0-9 digit bank with ASSISTS and TDM DEATHS headers (#137).
- Practice only: not sent, no referee submit. REAL MATCH users can stay on their current build.
